Farm_bot.changelog:
Changes in Farm bot:
- Added calculation of the best farming spot (without teleport) 
- Added nickname change even if teleport is disabled (approximately every 30 minutes) 
- Optimized certain features 
- Added check for any guild member's rally if the (Guild Rally Report) setting is enabled 
- Added talent switch to combat talents upon detecting a rally or a drop in power

Hunt.changelog:
Changes in Hunt:
- Fixed known bugs.
- User interface improvements (Monster hits now snap to the right edge of the main window). 
- Added a tooltip when hovering over the ‘Wait on’ button. 
- Minor optimizations
